"  - **Premium Sync Pop-up Overlay Modal**: Implemented a highly aesthetic, custom glassmorphism pop-up overlay window modal built on `framer-motion` (`AnimatePresence` and custom scale/fade transitions). Clicking the sync button triggers a scale-in popup with a spinning emerald ring loader. Upon a successful sync, the pop-up dynamically transitions into a satisfying scaling green checkmark animation that scales up and wipes clean using SVG path morphing, followed by a soft fade-out overlay closing.
  - **Realigned Refresh vs Load Menu Actions**: Strictly separated local cache refreshing from remote back-office syncing. Clicking the **Refresh** button/icon now performs a fast `localRefresh()` loading only from the client's high performance cached database (`localStorage`) to reload elements instantly without network overhead. Clicking the **Load Menu** option triggers a remote connection to the back office server (`handleSyncRefresh`), executing a complete live database synchronization and showcasing the premium animated pop-up modal.
